[LGRA.9.2.1] From lowest to highest (below binds looser):

```
 1. or
 2. and
 3. not                                             (unary prefix)
 4. == != < <= > >=                                 (chainable, [LGRA.9.3.2])
    is, is not                                      (does not chain, [LGRA.9.3.1])
 5. ??                                              (left-assoc)
 6. ~ !~                                            (at most one; a regex literal on the right)
 7. in contains overlaps                            (at most one)
 8. ..                                              (at most one)
 9. |                                               (bitwise or)
10. ^                                               (bitwise xor)
11. &                                               (bitwise and)
12. << >>                                           (bitwise shift)
13. + -                                             (binary; left-assoc)
14. * / // %                                        (left-assoc)
15. ** (right-assoc)
16. - + ~                                           (unary prefix)
17. . [ ] ( ) ::                                    (member access, index, call, conversion cast)
18. <primary>                                       (literals, identifiers, parens)
```

The productions ([LGRA.9.3.1], [LGRA.9.4.1], [LGRA.9.5.1], [LGRA.9.6.1],
